The network includes Anthropic, its funders, funded groups, and their PACs and lobbyists. Network funder Coefficient Giving listed a 2019 award to Georgetown’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET).

Start with the company: its employees’ own gifts, and its PAC’s.

The eleven kinds of record

Each of the 452 members with a record counts once in the chamber. Each bar counts all serving members with that kind of record. The bars can overlap and include members from either seat group. 119 of 452 have only records of what third parties did.

I · The arrival

Gifts from Anthropic employees and its PAC reached 10 of today’s members by the end of 2024 and 199 by Sept. 2026.

Anthropic employees gave $6.1M of their own money, 92% of it in 2026. The PAC gave $226K.

FEC contributions to campaigns, leadership PACs and single-member joint fundraising committees linked to serving members.

Employer is as the giver reported it to the FEC, including misspellings and entries in the occupation box. The amounts are gross contributions before refunds. Both counts use the Nov. 26, 2026 roster. The record runs through Sept. 30, 2026.

Employee and PAC gifts

$6.3M across 1,078 employee gifts and 96 PAC gifts through Sept. 30, 2026. The PAC’s first gift on record to a member now serving was on June 29, 2026. Each gridline on the first chart is ten times the level below. Givers who share a first name and surname count as one. Totals are gifts to committees linked to sitting members.
